source_refs.note: C. Reduction involving –COOH group: a main subheading of 23.5 Reactions of Carboxylic Acids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 110-110.

blocks.text: Powerful (taqatwar) reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, carboxylic acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Reduction (H lena ya O khona)
blocks.text:
i. H₂ (ya H⁻) ka milna
ii. O ya O₂ ka nikalna
iii. X₂ (halogens) ka nikalna
iv. Electrons ka milna
v. Oxidation state ka kam hona
Doosre aam reducing agents, H₂/Ni aur sodium tetrahydridoborate(III) (NaBH₄), carboxylic acids ko reduce nahi karte.
